findings.statement: A small calibrated spatial stencil reconstructs fixed withheld water pixels more accurately than unweighted local averaging on this daily map.

reliability.rationale: 23 held geographic tiles give 0.03284 degC MAE against local-mean 0.05750, but observations are dependent pixels from one processed map.
